summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K containing condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine quarterly report of a foreign private issuer, submitted pursuant to Rule 13a-16. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is described or referenced. The financial statements show a net loss of $13.4M for the period, primarily due to a $13.2M loss on derivative financial instruments, but this represents ordinary operating results, not a transformative corporate event. Watch for any subsequent 6-K or 8-K that might disclose a strategic transaction.
